verdicts.label: TRUE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: Widespread celebrations took place across India on August 23, 2023, to mark the successful landing of the Chandrayaan-3 mission on the Moon, and these events were widely photographed by news agencies.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple news outlets and photo archives, including Al Jazeera, The National News, Mid-day.com, Getty Images, and Alamy, published numerous photographs documenting widespread public celebrations across India on August 23, 2023, following the successful landing of the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft on the Moon. While other unrelated or fabricated visuals concerning the mission have been debunked, the event of people celebrating is well-documented and real.

signals_ai: No specific signals of AI generation were found for this type of image.
signals_real: The event depicted was real and widely photographed by multiple news agencies on the claimed date.
Numerous similar photographs exist in reputable photo archives like Getty Images and Alamy.
